engine.description: The engine to set up: "vite" (the @ng-doc/builder:vite-application and vite-dev-server builders) or "legacy" (the @ng-doc/builder:application and dev-server builders). By default a standalone application on Angular's application builder (or Nx's @nx/angular:application executor) gets the Vite engine; an NgModule application, or one on another builder, gets the legacy builders. A project that already uses NgDoc keeps its builders.
